g.text: Great Lakes institutions are not all regulators. Scientific information is not legal decision authority. Funding is not control. Tribal sovereignty is represented nation-specifically without inventing current Western Basin jurisdiction. Great Black Swamp remains C — HOLD; Toledo intake-coordinate discrepancy remains unresolved. No partisan/election analysis.
